description.value: strEATS is a Canadian fast-casual chain serving globally inspired street foods—think loaded pierogies, tacos, and buffalo-sauced dishes—made with fresh ingredients. The Aldergrove location sits on Fraser Highway in the Lower Mainland, positioning it as a potential refuelling stop for cyclists travelling this busy corridor. The brand highlights sustainability practices and community charity work alongside its eclectic, cross-cultural menu.
